name: Kiriya Kachiki
source:
Cousin of Erika. Her father was the former head of the Kiriya corporation before Erika took control from him. Is currently being pursued by Erika for having a envelope containing important information about company. Nearly identical to her cousin being seen as perfect in many ways and a natural leader, alongside being self centered. Small difference from cousin is that she doesn't love conflict and chaos who thrives off it possible because she has had to struggle growing up after father lost company. 

[spoiler] She does not like Erika as shown in her route. But if Erika is married to Leo, she and Erika will have a better relationship compared to the one shown. [/spoiler]

Likes: Curry
Dislikes: People who don't understand what Kachiki tells them
Hobbies: Being loved by others
